sentences.text: Advocate for the Petitioner : MR. S MUNIR Advocate for the Respondent :
BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MITALI THAKURIA  ORDER Date : 22.03.2023 Heard Mr. S. Munir, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. P.
Borthakur, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State respondent.
Page No.# 2/4

This is an application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973,
praying for grant of pre-arrest bail to the accused/petitioner, who has been apprehending arrest in connection with Jogighopa P.S. Case No. 96/2023, registered under Sections 120(B)/420/468/471/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text: 1 The learned counsel for the petitioner, Mr. S. Munir, submits that the accused/petitioner is innocent and no way connected with the alleged offence and his name has been falsely implicated here in this case.

He is a businessman dealing with the business of coal and the proprietor of a registered firm,
namely, M/S M. M. Traders.
The petitioner is ready to appear before the I.O. and shall co-operate in the further investigation of the case if is granted with the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail.
Further, this Court vide order dated 20.03.2023, in AB No. 1012/2023, while calling for the Case Diary, had already granted the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail to the prime accused of this case.

In this context, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Mr. P. Borthakur, has submitted that the name of the present accused/petitioner find mentioned in the F.I.R. and as per the allegation made in the F.I.R., he was submitting fake GST Challan and hence, his custodial interrogation may be necessary in this case and accordingly, raised objection in granting pre-arrest bail to the accused/petitioner.
Having heard the submissions of learned counsels of both sides, it is provided that the Case Diary be called for fixing 21.04.2023.

Further, considering the submissions of learned counsels for both sides and also considering the materials placed on record, I find it a fit case to extend the privilege of interim pre-arrest bail to the accused/petitioner till receipt of the Case Diary.

Accordingly, it is provided that in the event of arrest of the accused/petitioner, namely, Alekzander Rahman @ Alexandar Rahman, in connection with Jogighopa P.S. Case No. 96/2023, registered under Sections 120(B)/420/468/471/34 of the Indian Penal Code, he shall be enlarged on interim pre-arrest bail on his executing a bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) only with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, subject to the following conditions:
(i) that the petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer of the case within a period of 1 (one) week from today;
(ii) that the petitioner shall fully co-operate with the investigation of the case and shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when required in connection with the investigation of the aforesaid P.S. Case; and (iii) that the petitioner shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing Page No.# 4/4 such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
List the matter, accordingly, on 21.04.2023 along with AB/1012/2023.
